title: AC1024 alignment, flip, and linear grip DXF record profiles

source.fixturePolicy: Existing local input was read in place. No DWG/DXF fixture was added to Git; per-record DXF outputs were temporary and removed by the test selector.

independentStructuralComparison.fieldOrder: All three records use AcDbEvalExpr, AcDbBlockElement, and AcDbBlockGrip prefixes. Alignment and linear append AcDbBlockAlignmentGrip or AcDbBlockLinearGrip plus groups 140/141/142. Flip appends AcDbBlockFlipGrip, groups 140/141/142, then group 93 combined_state.
independentStructuralComparison.limits: Used as structural field-order and typed-field comparison only. The LibreDWG converter reports unrelated unstable associative-class warnings and is not a semantic or native-application oracle.

implementation.dxfRead: AC1024-only exact group sequence; bounded signed 32-bit integers, 0/1 cycling flag, finite location/orientation, exact subclass tail, and retained element-name budget. Extra or malformed body groups remain raw-only.
implementation.dxfWrite: AC1024-only typed profile; source handle/owner retained, 29/2 source EvalExpr and element versions projected to 33/29, class-specific orientation and flip combined-state fields emitted in the observed order.
implementation.notQualified: The architectural source still has nine other dynamic-block class families and two EvaluationGraph roots. This per-record proof does not admit the full source graph or qualify native dynamic-block behavior.

authoredProfiles.result: PASS, 1/1; ASCII and Binary exact groups, typed readback, non-finite refusal preserving destination, and corrected same-writer retry for each grip class.

physicalProfiles.result: PASS; all 2 alignment, 3 flip, and 4 linear grips emitted individually in ASCII and Binary and freshly reimported with typed field comparisons.

validation.fullSuites: NOT RUN; focused warning-as-error build and fast record-level test used.
